changed_output_review.assessment: Both remain Portuguese, join the authored Então correctly, and do not import the unrelated battery/charger facts. Short fragments do not establish downstream contextual utility; retain uncertainty rather than claim human-rated equivalence.

component_batch_experiment.scope: component-only completed prompt evaluation; pinned library, no sampling, IPC, UI or cancellation claim
component_batch_experiment.decision: Retain logical batch 64; larger batches showed no reliable advantage beyond baseline drift and would widen cancellation boundaries.

limits: WindowServer panel appearance is not a timestamp of the first painted glyph; actual glyphs were inspected separately.
Synthetic local NSTextView edits, not physical typing, and small controlled sample counts.
No cache eviction between app launches: first-request observations are not a controlled cold-start comparison.
Worker samples exclude debounce, native context preparation, rendering and the desktop supervisor.
Direct diagnostic phase timings synchronize the backend and must not replace uninstrumented worker timings.
No smaller model, reduced context or sampler-policy shortcut; existing nine quality failures remain.
Worker and GUI engine whole-file digests differ and are recorded separately; comparisons are within each matched execution path, not a cross-path ratio.
